mission: Build the native ShortForge Editor page and safely connect existing generated Shorts

okf.summary: Architecture and code paths reviewed. Follow-up is required because legacy jobs lack a guaranteed editable source manifest and export is intentionally disabled.

forgers.name: product-design
findings: Generation READY panel and Media Library route to a dedicated editor page.
Legacy flattened imports are clearly labelled and do not claim recovered scene/question layers.

forgers.name: editor-runtime
findings: Existing CompositionIR and DurableEditor are reused.
CAS sources are resolved server-side and actual bytes are hash checked before compilation.
A regression test covers successful CAS resolution and tamper rejection.

forgers.name: render-security
findings: A dedicated editor playback route now verifies session, job ownership, source binding, byte length and SHA-256.
No production export endpoint is exposed by this change; export remains locked pending worker input staging, Treasury admission, F06 output and F07 evidence.

forgers.name: timeline-interchange
findings: F02 narrative format is propagated into the F03 handoff and F05 canonical TimelineSpec rather than defaulting every timeline to FACTS_SHORTS.
F05 canonical bridge preserves scene IDs, source versions, source trims, caption scene/position/font-style metadata and transitions.
TypeScript TimelineIR upgrade maps source trims, scene/source metadata, transitions and caption metadata into CompositionIR.
Regression tests cover F02-to-F03 quiz format propagation, F05 bridge field preservation, and TimelineIR-to-CompositionIR upgrade.

forgers.name: source-package
findings: Added a bounded EditorSourcePackage builder that stages real source files into CAS, validates signatures, saves CompositionIR as an immutable CAS artifact, and records owner/job/source hashes.
Floor 05 orchestration attempts package creation from the same RenderIntent used for F06 and persists a successful package in the completed VideoJob manifest.
The editor source API verifies package schema, job/owner binding, composition hash/length and each source asset's actual CAS digest before opening it.
Missing placeholder media and template-specific LocalRenderIntent intentionally fall back; the Python canonical F05 TimelineIR is not yet directly packaged for every job.

forgers.name: caption-editing
findings: Added a revision-checked UPDATE_CAPTION_TEXT operation to the canonical editor command engine.
Studio now exposes a caption inspector and Apply caption text action; flattened jobs with no independent caption cues explain the limitation.
Regression tests cover successful text change, preservation of scene metadata, and rejection of empty/unknown captions.
Successful editor receipts now expose changedCaptionIds so downstream verification can identify caption-level changes rather than treating them as an empty clip edit.

security.notes: Code-path controls were added, but automated security scans and browser/API adversarial tests have not yet qualified this feature.

proposedResolutions.proposal: Keep export disabled until F05 source manifest, worker-side source staging/hash validation, server-authorized Treasury, F06 render, CAS output and F07 receipt are integrated and tested.
Import old completed MP4s as one explicitly labelled clip. Do not invent original scenes, question data, captions, or independent narration.
Use external editor repositories as feature/architecture references. Review all licenses before vendoring or adding dependencies.

Preserve F02 narrative format and F05 scene/asset/trim/transition/caption metadata through the canonical interchange model. Next still requires portable CAS staging and an owner-bound source-manifest link from F06 into the editor job manifest.

Persist an owner-bound CAS composition package when every real RenderIntent dependency resolves; reject placeholder or unsupported sources and retain labelled flattened fallback. Follow up by packaging the canonical F05 TimelineIR plus source media for non-template and template execution paths.

acceptedResolutions.resolution: Reuse CompositionIR, DurableEditor and the existing Studio rather than creating a competing timeline runtime.
Use an authenticated owner-bound playback endpoint and verify the physical CAS digest before serving source bytes.
Retain F05 TimelineIR as a canonical source boundary and upgrade it to CompositionIR without discarding supported source scene identities, source trim ranges, caption metadata or transitions.
Edit caption text only through a typed, revision-checked command and preserve existing caption timing, style and scene metadata.

finalDisposition.reason: Current draft includes the dedicated page, best-effort CAS source packages with truthful fallback, F02-F05 timeline semantic preservation, caption text editing and caption-aware receipts. Current-head CI/browser/security qualification remains pending; the canonical F05 package path is not portable for every renderer, and safe export remains disabled.
